notes: Every archive the Android feasibility point downloads is pinned to an exact version with a committed sha256 that is verified before extraction; nothing is installed host-global. Digests were taken from each vendor's own publication (Adoptium release metadata, services.gradle.org .sha256, python-build-standalone SHA256SUMS, PyPI JSON) except the command-line tools zip, whose sha256 was computed over the artifact Google's repository XML names and cross-checked against Google's published sha1. The fleet hosts are linux x86_64; hosts of another architecture are reported pending, never silently substituted.

host_python.purpose: Task-private CPython 3.13: runs cibuildwheel and is wired to Gradle as Chaquopy buildPython, whose major.minor must match the app's embedded Python 3.13 (chaquo.com/chaquopy/doc/current/android.html#buildpython).

cibuildwheel.purpose: Builds the Android cp313 wheels from the pinned zstandard sdist on the fleet, per chaquo/chaquopy server/pypi/README.md (the supported builder for Python 3.13+; Chaquopy 17 does not cross-build native sdists, and its pip block accepts local wheels only through --find-links plus an exact requirement).
